name: greygoo
title: greygoo
blurb: play an invading AI from the future assembling itself from an enemy facility's resources — qwoplike now: reach for nodes with two independently-controlled arms (Q/W, O/P), overextend and you stumble, get too much security attention and you're purged, botch the final cascade and it fizzles. asked for by @bitfuktangel.bsky.social, who came back to ask for the redo after the first pass felt railroaded into a boring victory; @bisks.net waved the original through with "let's do it anyway, what's the worst that goes wrong."
